AGENDA

  THE CITY OF LA VERNE

  CITY COUNCIL

  Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Council meetings are welcomed and
  appreciated. Community engagement provides the City Council with valuable information. Regular
  st  rd
  Meetings are held on the 1 and 3 Monday of every month. In compliance with the American
  Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
  participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior
  to the meeting
  .
  Individuals may contact the City Clerk’s Office for guidance on how to request an item to be added to a
  future Agenda. Materials related to an item on this agenda, submitted to the Council after distribution
  of the agenda packet, are available for public inspection at the meeting or in the City Clerk’s Office
  during normal business hours.

  1.  CALL TO ORDER

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  3.  ROLL CALL:  Council Member Carder, Council Member Davis, Council Member Hepburn,
  Mayor Pro Tem Rosales, and Mayor Kendrick
 AGENDA, La Verne City Council Adjourned Meeting, Monday, June 03, 2019, Page 2

  4.  2018-19 CITY BUDGET - The purpose of this adjourned meeting is for the La Verne City Council
  to meet in a study session to review and conceptually approve
  the 2019-20 budget.

  a. Overview & Presentation of the 2019-20 Fiscal Year City Budget in the amount of
  $66,147,019 byCity Manager Robert Russi.

  b. Presentation of City Departmental Budgets

  1.  Budget Pages 46-100 General Administration, City Clerk, City Manager -
  includes Personnel & Risk Management, Finance, and Information Systems
  presented by Personnel Officer JR Ranells, Finance Officer Nathan Statham and
  Information Systems Manager Bill Elftman, Jr.

  2.  Budget Pages 101-122 Community Development Department presented by
  Director of Community Development Eric Scherer.

  3.  Budget Pages 123-145 Fire Department presented by Interim Fire Chief Kirk
  Summers.

  4.  Budget Pages 146-177 Police presented by Police Chief Nick Paz.

  5.  Budget Pages 178-192 Community Services D e p a r t m e n t presented by Director
  of Community Services Bill Aguirre.

  6.  Budget Pages 193-269 Public Works Department - Includes Water, Streets, Fleet
  Maintenance, Building Maintenance & Parks presented by Assistant City
  Manager/Director of Public Works Dan Keesey.

  7.  Budget Pages 270-284 Overview of Major Capital Improvements, Capital
  Equipment Outlay and Special Programs presented by Assistant City
  Manager/Director of Public Works Dan Keesey.

  Staff Recommendation:  Minute motion to conceptually approve the La Verne
  City budget is appropriate. A Resolution for the formal
  approval of the City budget will be scheduled for the
  June 17, 2019, City Council meeting.
 AGENDA, La Verne City Council Adjourned Meeting, Monday, June 03, 2019, Page 3

5.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - This is the time set aside for anyone
  wishing to address the City Council on items not listed in any other place on the agenda.
  Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the legislative body is prohibited from talking or
  engaging in discussion on any item not appearing on the posted agenda. However, your
  concerns may be referred to staff or set for discussion at a later date. Any person desiring
  to speak should complete a ‘Speaker Card,’ located at the podium, and hand it to the
  Assistant City Clerk. When addressing the Council, please go to the podium and state your
  Name and Address for the record. The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration of
  comments.

6.  ADJOURNMENT

MINUTES OF THE AN ADJOURNED MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL  OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE HELD IN THE COUNCIL  CHAMBERS
  OF THE LA VERNE CITY HALL
  Monday, June 3, 2019

1.  A regular meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Kendrick at 4: 30 p. m.

2.  Council Members  present:  Mayor pon Kendrick
  Mayor Pro Tem  Muir Davis
  Council  Member  Robin Garder
  Council Member Charlie Rosales
  Council Member Tim Hepburn

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel  present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  City Attorney Robert L. Kress
  Assistant City Manager/ Public Works Director Dan Keesey
  Assistant City Clerk Lupe Gaeta Estrella
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer
  Community Services Director Bill Aguirre
  Police Chief Nick Paz
  Interim Fire Chief Kirk Summers
  Finance Manager Nathan Statham
  Personnel  Officer JR Ranells
  Police Captain  Colleen  Flores
  Police Lieutenant Sam Gonzalez
  Deputy Public Works Director Anthony Ciotti
  Public Works Director Tracey Costello
  Fleet Superintendent Bob Crawford
  Water Manager Richard Martinez
  Recreation  Coordinator  Yvonne  Duran

  Senior Management Specialist Christy Lopez
  Principal Planner Candice Bowcock
  Senior Planner Luke Siebert
  Parks Manger Clay Jarvinen

3.  Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Kendrick.

4.  Overview &  Presentation  of  City Manager Russi reported that the purpose of the adjourned meeting is for
  the 2019- 20 Fiscal  Year  City  the City Council to meet with the departments to review and conceptually
  Budget  approve the 2019- 20 budgets prior to the final adoption of the budget at the
  regular  meeting  scheduled  after  this meeting  at  6: 30  pm.  He stated that each
  Department Head would have an opportunity to report on their DepartmenYs
  budget.

  City Manager Russi reported and gave an overview on the 2019- 20 City
  Budget in the amount  of$  66, 147, 019 along  with  a slide  presentation.  He
  stated there was no significant change and that there would be an estimated
  9 million  in reserves.  He reported on personnel  related expenses, and on

  the status of the Fiscal Sustainability Plan, the City' s resources, expenses,
  and Capital Outlay/ Capital Improvement  Projects ( CIP). He spoke about the
  tax measure  being contemplated to be placed on the March 2020 ballot.
  City Council Adjourned  Minutes,  Monday, June 3, 2019, Page 2

  City Manager Russi thanked  the  City Council for their support.  He
  commended Finance Manager Statham for his work on putting together his
  first budget and he also thanked the Finance  staff.  He thanked the efforts of
  the managers and department heads in substantially balancing the budget.
  Presentation of Citv Departmental Budaets

General Administration, City  Personnel Officer Ranells  the General  Administration,
  presented
  City Clerk,
Clerk, City Manager- includes  City Manager which includes Personnel & Risk Management and Information
Personnel &  Risk Management,  Systems Departments Budgets ( Budget Pages 46- 100).  He reported on the
Finance,  and  Information  elimination of the medical  insurance for City Council and the savings.  He
Systems
  spoke about the cost of the upcoming election in March of 2020 and that the
  City of La Verne will be consolidating with the County of Los Angeles. He
  reported that there has been an increase in recruitment and that the Personnel
  Office was now paying for a testing service for fire applicants. In addition, he

  reported that the Information Systems Department has contracted with Swag
  IT for live streaming of the City Council meetings and that they anticipate live
  streaming before September of 2019.

  Finance Manager Statham reported there were no major changes in the
  Finance Department.  He stated that they would be hiring another full- time
  Account Clerk that was funded last year but never filled.

Community  Development  Director  of  CommunityDevelopmentScherer  presented the Community
Department  Development Department Budget ( Budget Pages 104 - 125).  He reported on
  the increase in
  building permit revenues. He spoke about the La Verne
  Landing Housing and the University of La Verne Citrus Hall projects. In
  addition,  he reported on the General Plan and the recent adoptions of the
  Brethren Hillcrest Homes, Damien High School and the University of La Verne
  Master Plan  updates,  Gold Line Project, the Enhanced  Infrastructure Financing
  District ( EIFD) and Old Town La Verne.

Fire Department  Interim Fire Chief Kirk Summers presented the Fire Department Budget
  Budget Pages 126- 148).  He reported there were no change in personnel and
  no new programs.  He spoke about the replacement of a chest compression
  system,  gurney upgrades and the purchase of a Type- 6 Fire Engine for fire
  operations.  He stated that the purchase of the Type- 6 Fire Engine would give
  first responders  better  access  to certain  areas  in the City.  In addition, he
  reported on the Fire Station remodel project and the upgrade to the dispatch
  communication  operations.

Police Department  Police Chief Paz presented the Police Department Budget ( Budget Pages 149-
  180). He reported that they will be hiring a lieutenant which was left vacant
  last year, one officer will be deployed to LA IMPACT and fully funded by LA
  Impact and they will be reassigning a full- time motor officer. He stated they
  are looking at contracting out for jail operations. He also spoke about the
  Police Department'  s online crime  reporting  portal  on  their website. He thanked
  Finance Manager Statham and Senior Management Analyst Lopez for their
  assistance in preparing the Police Department budget.

Community Services  Director  of
  Community Services Aguirre presented the Community Services
Department  Department Budget ( Budget Pages 181- 195).  He reported on the Community
  Services Programs, replacement  of the  Veteran' s Hall roof, and the status of
  the Teen Center project.
   City Council Adjourned Minutes, Monday, June 3, 2019, Page 3

  Public Works Department-  Deputy Director of Public Works Ciotti presented the Public Works
  Includes Water, Streets, Fleet  Department Budget which includes Water, Streets, Fleet Maintenance,
  Maintenance,  Building  Building Maintenance& Parks( Budget Pages 196- 272). He reported on the
  Maintenance&  Parks  new contract for street sweeping, awarded construction projects, and storm
  water objectives.
  He also reported that in the 2018- 19 budget process, the
  funding for a maintenance worker was inadvertently left out and that position is
  being reinstated.

  Overview of  Major  Capital
  Assistant City Manager/ Director of Public Works Dan Keesey presented an
  Improvements, Capital
  overview of the Capital Improvement Projects, Capital Equipment Outlay and
  Equipment  Outlay and Special  Special Programs( Budget Pages 273- 286).  He reported on the water
  Programs  construction  projects and improvements,  bicycle path project, Edison
  Underground Utilities and Fruit Street Median project, Type- 6 Fire Engine and
  sidewalk projects.

  The City Council thanked City Manager Russi, Department Heads, staff and
  especially the Finance Department for all their hard work in preparing the
  budget.

  It was moved by Rosales, seconded by Hepburn and unanimously carried to
  conceptually  approve  the La  Verne City budget. A Resolution for the formal
  approval of the City budget- was scheduled for the June 17, 2019, City Council
  meeting.

5.  Public Comment
  This was the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the City Council on
  items not listed in any other  place  on  the  agenda.  Mayor Kendrick called for
  public  comment.

  There was none.

6.  Adjournment

  Respectfully submitted,

  Lupe Gaeta Estrella, CMC
  Assistant City Clerk
